housing.summary: Average rent for a 1-bedroom apartment in Jönköping city centre is approximately 9,000 SEK/month per Numbeo (Jun 2026). Deposit norm in Sweden is typically 1-3 months rent. Main rental portals are blocket.se (now qasa.se) and hemnet.se.

banking.summary: Major Swedish banks in Jönköping include Swedbank, Handelsbanken, SEB, and Nordea. To open an account newcomers need: valid passport or national ID, Swedish personnummer or samordningsnummer, proof of address, and sometimes proof of employment or income.
required_docs: Proof of employment or income (some banks)

schools.summary: Jönköping is in Jönköping County. The city hosts Jönköping University and has a relatively international community. International schools and IB options exist in the region. The Swedish national school directory is at Skolverket.
curricula: IB (International Baccalaureate) available in Jönköping region

legal_admin.summary: All persons moving to Sweden must register with Skatteverket via Folkbokföring (population registration) within 3 months. In Jönköping, this is done at a local Skatteverket service office. Required to obtain a personnummer and access public services.

tax_finance.summary: Personnummer is assigned by Skatteverket upon Folkbokföring. It is a 10-digit personal identity number essential for all interactions with public and private institutions in Sweden.

transport.summary: Public transport in Jönköping is operated by Jönköpings Länstrafik (JLT). The 30-day adult pass for 1 zone costs 815 SEK (standard price as of Jul 2026, per jlt.se). Note: a temporary half-price campaign (407 SEK) runs July–December 2026. EU/EEA driving licences valid indefinitely in Sweden; non-EU licences valid 1 year after residency then must be exchanged. Healthcare via Region Jönköpings Län vårdcentral.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences remain valid in Sweden indefinitely. Non-EU licences valid for 1 year from registration; thereafter exchange required via Transportstyrelsen.
transport.healthcare_registration: Register with a Region Jönköpings Län vårdcentral (primary care centre) at 1177.se
